summary: Quiet street kerb beside bush; houses 14-25 m away across the road.
reasons: Bush on the east side of the kerb

best_section.where: East kerb of Carinya Street, beside the bush south of the side lane

drivers.seclusion: Bush backs the east kerb; the nearest house is 14 m away across the road, more homes to the south-west.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street; verge beside the kerb is bush and grass, room to pull off is unclear.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, local traffic only.
drivers.convention: One car parked at the junction; no signs and no clear kerbside parking habit.

flags: Homes within 25 m across the road
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by bush canopy to the east and south-east.
